senses.en: someone admired for courage, achievements, or good actions
the main male character in a story

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on national hero.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论民族英雄。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of national hero.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得民族英雄这个例子。

tip: 复数为heroes；故事中的hero不一定品德高尚。

senses.en: The feeling of being unhappy, especially after loss or disappointment.

ex.en: The textbook introduces deep sadness in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了深切的悲伤。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss deep sadness.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论深切的悲伤的材料。

col: a sense of sadness｜一种悲伤感
tip: 通常作不可数名词；a sense of sadness指一种悲伤感。

senses.en: one of the main sections of a book

senses.zh: 人生或历史的重要阶段
senses.en: a distinct period in someone's life or in history
a local branch of a larger organisation

ex.en: I copied the opening chapter into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把开篇章节抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the opening chapter.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕开篇章节展开说明。

col: a chapter in history｜历史上的一个阶段
tip: 书的“章”用chapter；章内较小部分常用section。

senses.en: to make something current or give someone the latest information
new information or a change that makes something more current

ex.en: The lab instructions say to update software.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求更新软件。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to update software.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得更新软件。

col: update someone on something｜告知某人某事的最新情况
tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，读/ˈʌpdeɪt/。

senses.en: To give all your attention to a particular task.
To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there.
A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.

ex.en: The assignment is to concentrate on a task, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先专注于任务，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to concentrate on a task and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你专注于任务，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: concentrate on a task｜专注于任务
concentrate resources on｜将资源集中于
tip: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

senses.en: To make someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to embarrass someone.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求使某人尴尬。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers embarrass someone before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要使某人尴尬。

tip: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事情令人尴尬用embarrassing。

senses.en: relating to nature or efforts to protect it
relating to the surroundings in which people or organisms live

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on environmental protection.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论环境保护。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of environmental protection.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得环境保护这个例子。

tip: environmental是形容词，环境本身用environment。

senses.en: So surprising that it is difficult to believe
Extremely good, impressive, or great in amount

ex.en: I copied an incredible achievement into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把惊人的成就抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an incredible achievement.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论惊人的成就的材料。

col: find it incredible｜觉得难以置信
tip: incredible可表难以置信，也可口语赞叹“极好”。

senses.en: The duty to manage something or answer for its results.
A task or duty that you are expected to handle.

ex.en: Office hours began with a sense of responsibility.
ex.zh: 答疑从责任感开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a sense of responsibility when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了责任感。

tip: 泛指责任常不可数；具体职责可数；后常接for。

senses.en: Someone trained to install and repair electrical systems.

ex.en: Our professor circled qualified electrician on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了合格电工。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of qualified electrician.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得合格电工这个例子。

tip: electrician指电工；电气工程师是electrical engineer。

senses.en: a single part or quantity within a larger whole
a device or separate part of a machine
a group organised for a particular task

ex.en: Office hours began with a family unit.
ex.zh: 答疑从家庭单位开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a family unit.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论家庭单位的材料。

col: a unit of measurement｜计量单位
an intensive care unit｜重症监护病房
tip: 表示计量单位时常用a unit of，后接所计量的事物。

senses.en: To give a loud, high cry from strong emotion.
A loud, high cry expressing fear, pain, or excitement.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to scream with excitement.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求兴奋地尖叫。

ex.en: The passage says students who can scream with excitement follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够兴奋地尖叫的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: let out a scream｜发出一声尖叫
tip: scream强调声音尖厉；shout只强调喊得响。

senses.en: Having great physical strength or producing a strong effect.
Able to control people or strongly influence events.

ex.en: I copied powerful engine into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把动力强劲的发动机抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects powerful engine with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把动力强劲的发动机和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: powerful engine｜动力强劲的发动机
tip: 通常作形容词；副词用powerfully，不用powerful。

senses.en: Literature using carefully arranged language, rhythm, and imagery.
Beauty or emotional power resembling that of poems.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on modern poetry.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论现代诗歌。

ex.en: The reading connects modern poetry with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把现代诗歌和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: poetry不可数；一首诗用a poem，不用a poetry。

senses.en: Showing poor judgement or a lack of good sense.

ex.en: I copied a foolish mistake into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把愚蠢的错误抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a foolish mistake with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把愚蠢的错误和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: foolish to assume｜贸然假定是不明智的
tip: 常用It is foolish to do表示做某事不明智。

senses.en: Find the size, amount, or degree of something.
An action intended to achieve a particular result.
A way of judging the quality or degree of something.

ex.en: The professor asked us to measure progress.
ex.zh: 教授让我们衡量进展。

ex.en: The passage says students who can measure progress follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够衡量进展的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: take measures to do something｜采取措施做某事
a measure of success｜衡量成功的标准
tip: 采取措施用 take measures；测量某物直接接宾语。

senses.en: A picture or visual representation of someone or something.
The impression that people have of a person or organization.
A picture of someone or something formed in your mind.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about digital image.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于数字图像的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects digital image with a larger point about public communication.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把数字图像和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 既可指具体图像，也可指个人或机构的公众形象。

senses.en: an imaginary creature that is large, strange, or frightening
a person who behaves in an extremely cruel way
extremely large in size or amount

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sea monster.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论海怪。

ex.en: A campus survey used sea monster to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用海怪来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

tip: 形容词用法较口语化，置于名词前表示巨大。

senses.en: A result or level that someone aims to achieve.
A person or thing aimed at or attacked.
To direct actions or attention towards a particular person or group.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about target audience.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于目标受众的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects target audience with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把目标受众和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: target vulnerable groups｜针对弱势群体
tip: 表示达成目标用meet或reach a target。

senses.en: Able to speak or write a language easily and smoothly.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about fluent in English.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于英语流利的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fluent in English.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕英语流利展开说明。

col: a fluent speaker｜表达流利的人
tip: 说某种语言流利用be fluent in；流利不等于零错误。

senses.en: Relating to the sun.
Using energy from sunlight to produce heat or electricity.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on solar energy.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论太阳能。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around solar energy.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕太阳能展开说明。

tip: solar是形容词，常用于太阳或太阳能相关搭配。

senses.en: The opportunity or right to enter or use something.
A way of reaching or entering a place.
Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about internet access.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于互联网接入的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects internet access with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把互联网接入和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会
tip: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something wrong or disappointing
unwilling to do something because it feels embarrassing

ex.en: Office hours began with ashamed of yourself.
ex.zh: 答疑从为自己感到羞愧开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around ashamed of yourself.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕为自己感到羞愧展开说明。

col: ashamed of yourself｜为自己感到羞愧
tip: 常作表语：be ashamed of或be ashamed to do。

senses.en: Money received regularly from work, investments, or other sources.

ex.en: Our professor circled low income on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了低收入。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss low income.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论低收入的材料。

tip: income范围比salary广，也包括租金、投资收益。

senses.en: a frightening or deeply unpleasant dream
an experience or situation that is extremely unpleasant or difficult

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on recurring nightmare.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论反复出现的噩梦。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of recurring nightmare.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得反复出现的噩梦这个例子。

col: logistical nightmare｜组织协调上的大难题
tip: 通常作可数名词；形容词形式为nightmarish。

senses.en: To become smaller or make something smaller in amount.
A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to decrease significantly.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求显著减少。

ex.en: The passage says students who can decrease significantly follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够显著减少的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: a decrease in demand｜需求下降
tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

senses.en: something said or written to express an opinion or observation
to express an opinion or observation about something

ex.en: Office hours began with no comment.
ex.zh: 答疑从无可奉告开始。

ex.en: The author returns to no comment when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了无可奉告。

tip: 动词comment后接on再接评论对象，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: The earth in which plants grow.
To make something dirty.

ex.en: Office hours began with fertile soil.
ex.zh: 答疑从肥沃的土壤开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of fertile soil.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得肥沃的土壤这个例子。

tip: 土壤一般不可数；不同土质可用复数soils。

senses.en: the possibility that something harmful or unpleasant will happen
do something despite the possibility of harm or loss

ex.en: After the lecture, we used risk in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了风险。

ex.en: Students who can explain risk usually follow the rest of a lecture on public health.
ex.zh: 能解释风险的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共卫生的讲座。

tip: risk后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: a plan showing when activities or events will happen
to arrange for something to happen at a particular time

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a busy schedule.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论繁忙的日程。

ex.en: The author returns to a busy schedule when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了繁忙的日程。

tip: 英音开头通常为/ʃ/，美音为/sk/；on schedule指准时。

senses.en: something incorrect in an action, calculation, or judgement
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: The textbook introduces human error in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了人为失误。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss human error.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论人为失误的材料。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: the feeling of needing rest or sleep

ex.en: I copied extreme tiredness into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把极度疲劳抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss extreme tiredness.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论极度疲劳的材料。

tip: 通常不可数；形容人疲倦用tired，事物累人用tiring。

senses.en: Someone who supports a person, belief, or movement
Someone who subscribes to another user's social media updates

ex.en: I copied a devoted follower into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把忠实追随者抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a devoted follower when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了忠实追随者。

col: social media followers｜社交媒体关注者
tip: 表示追随者或账号关注者，不一定是狂热粉丝。

senses.en: the act of speaking to God or a god
words spoken to God or a god

ex.en: The textbook introduces daily prayer in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了每日祈祷。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around daily prayer.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕每日祈祷展开说明。

col: a prayer for peace｜祈求和平的祷告
tip: 表示祈祷活动常不可数；一段祷词可数。

senses.en: To put information on an official list
An official list or record of people or things
To show or record an amount on a measuring instrument

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to register for a course.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须报名课程。

ex.en: The passage says students who can register for a course follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够报名课程的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: register for a course｜报名课程
register to vote｜登记成为选民
register a complaint｜正式提出投诉
tip: 报名课程用register for；登记做某事用register to do。

senses.en: Admiration for someone or consideration for their rights and feelings.
To value someone or follow a rule or agreement.
A particular feature or aspect of something.

ex.en: I copied mutual respect into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把相互尊重抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mutual respect.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕相互尊重展开说明。

tip: 名词常接for；动词直接接宾语，不加for。

senses.en: The process of taking one amount away from another.

ex.en: Office hours began with addition and subtraction.
ex.zh: 答疑从加法与减法开始。

ex.en: The reading connects addition and subtraction with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把加法与减法和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: subtract A from B表示B减A，注意顺序。

senses.en: Knowledge of something, or sympathy for someone's feelings and situation.
Patient and sympathetic towards other people's feelings or difficulties.
An informal agreement between people or groups.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about mutual understanding.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于相互理解的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mutual understanding.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论相互理解的材料。

col: a clear understanding of｜对……的清楚理解
an understanding friend｜善解人意的朋友
tip: 表示“对……的理解”用understanding of。

senses.en: Something you can choose from a range of possibilities.
The right or opportunity to choose whether to do something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the best option in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最佳选择。

ex.en: A campus survey used the best option to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用最佳选择来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: have no option but to｜别无选择只能
keep your options open｜保留选择余地
the option to buy｜购买的选择权
tip: option指可选方案；have no option but to后接动词原形。

senses.en: A marked face or rotating control on an instrument
Enter a telephone number to make a call

ex.en: The textbook introduces a clock dial in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了钟面。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a clock dial.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕钟面展开说明。

tip: 过去式英式常用dialled，美式常用dialed。

senses.en: extremely good or impressive

ex.en: Our professor circled a marvelous opportunity on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了绝佳的机会。

ex.en: The reading connects a marvelous opportunity with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把绝佳的机会和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: marvelous为美式拼写；英式通常写marvellous。

senses.en: Something that must be done, possessed, or provided
Something needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: The textbook introduces a legal requirement in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了法律规定的要求。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a legal requirement.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕法律规定的要求展开说明。

col: a legal requirement｜法律规定的要求
tip: 满足要求用meet requirements，不用reach。

senses.en: to have enough money or resources for something
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: I heard the lecturer afford protection during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时提供保护。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to afford protection.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们提供保护。

col: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事
cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去
tip: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

senses.en: Feeling as if you or your surroundings are spinning.

ex.en: I copied a dizzy spell into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把一阵眩晕抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a dizzy spell with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一阵眩晕和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 人作主语用feel dizzy；事物可make人dizzy。

senses.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to gain an unfair advantage.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on prevent cheating.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论防止作弊。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss prevent cheating.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论防止作弊的材料。

col: accuse someone of cheating｜指责某人作弊
tip: cheating作行为名词通常不可数；cheat也可指作弊者。

senses.en: Mental strain caused by difficult situations or too many demands
To give particular importance to something when speaking or writing
Extra force used when pronouncing a syllable or word

ex.en: Office hours began with reduce stress.
ex.zh: 答疑从减轻压力开始。

ex.en: The author returns to reduce stress when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了减轻压力。

col: stress the importance of｜强调…的重要性
tip: 人感到压力用stressed；事情令人紧张用stressful。

senses.en: Not present where someone is expected to be.
Not existing or found in a particular place or situation.

ex.en: Office hours began with conspicuously absent.
ex.zh: 答疑从明显缺席的开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of conspicuously absent.
ex.zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得明显缺席的这个例子。

tip: 表示缺席某场合用absent from，不用absent in。

senses.en: a person who writes poems

ex.en: Our professor circled a celebrated poet on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了著名诗人。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a celebrated poet.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕著名诗人展开说明。

tip: poet指诗人，poem指一首诗，poetry统称诗歌。

senses.en: The study of how societies produce, distribute, and use resources.
The financial factors affecting whether an activity is practical.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about behavioural economics.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于行为经济学的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to behavioural economics when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了行为经济学。

col: the economics of recycling｜回收利用的经济可行性
tip: 指学科时虽以s结尾，仍接单数谓语。

senses.en: very pleased about something

ex.en: The textbook introduces absolutely delighted in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了欣喜万分。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss absolutely delighted.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论欣喜万分的材料。

col: delighted with the result｜对结果非常满意
delighted to hear｜听到后很高兴
tip: 人感到高兴用delighted；事物令人愉快用delightful。

senses.en: A device that captures sound for recording or making it louder.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a wireless microphone.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于无线麦克风的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a wireless microphone.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得无线麦克风这个例子。

col: speak into a microphone｜对着麦克风讲话
tip: microphone收音；speaker播放声音，勿混淆。

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an oil drum.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论油桶。

ex.en: A campus survey used an oil drum to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用油桶来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。

senses.en: A performer who entertains people by doing seemingly impossible tricks.
A person believed or imagined to have magical powers.

ex.en: I copied performing magician into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把表演魔术师抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around performing magician.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕表演魔术师展开说明。

col: skilled magician｜技艺娴熟的魔术师
tip: 现实中指魔术表演者；故事中也可指魔法师。

senses.en: Relating to skilled work or an activity done for payment.
Showing the skill and behaviour expected of a trained worker.
Someone trained for skilled work or paid to perform.

ex.en: Our professor circled healthcare professional on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了医疗专业人员。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕医疗专业人员展开说明。

tip: 与amateur对比强调职业；形容态度时强调专业得体。

senses.en: very important, large, or serious
a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on major problem.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论重大问题。

ex.en: The author returns to major problem when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了重大问题。

tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: mathematics involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division

ex.en: I copied mental arithmetic into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把心算抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of mental arithmetic.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得心算这个例子。

tip: 作名词通常不可数；范围比mathematics窄。

senses.en: the production of goods in factories
businesses that provide a particular type of product or service
steady effort and hard work

ex.en: I copied heavy industry into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把重工业抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to heavy industry when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了重工业。

tip: 工业用industrial；勤奋的用industrious。

senses.en: A situation that makes it possible to do something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces an opportunity to learn in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学习的机会。

ex.en: A campus survey used an opportunity to learn to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用学习的机会来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: an opportunity to learn｜学习的机会
tip: 常用an opportunity to do，表示做某事的机会。

senses.en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things.
To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or another method.
Someone you know who can offer help or information.

ex.en: I copied direct contact into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把直接接触抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used direct contact to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用直接接触来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: keep in contact with｜与……保持联系
tip: 动词contact直接接人，不加with；名词后可加with。

senses.en: To stop something happening or someone doing something.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to prevent accidents.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须预防事故。

ex.en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to prevent accidents.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们预防事故。

col: prevent someone from doing｜阻止某人做某事
tip: 用prevent sb from doing，不用prevent sb to do。

senses.en: very angry
behaving or thinking in an unreasonable or foolish way
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something

ex.en: The textbook introduces mad about football in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了痴迷足球。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mad about football.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕痴迷足球展开说明。

tip: mad at表示生气；mad about可表示痴迷。

senses.en: A place where people are kept as punishment or awaiting trial.
Put someone in jail.

ex.en: I copied a jail sentence into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把监禁刑期抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a jail sentence when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了监禁刑期。

col: be jailed for fraud｜因诈骗被监禁
tip: in jail指在押，不加冠词；英式旧拼法为gaol。

senses.en: something that makes success harder or reduces something's value

ex.en: Office hours began with a major disadvantage.
ex.zh: 答疑从重大弊端开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a major disadvantage.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得重大弊端这个例子。

col: at a disadvantage｜处于不利地位
tip: 表示处于不利地位用at a disadvantage。

senses.en: easy to recognise because you have encountered it before
having knowledge or experience of something

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on familiar with.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论熟悉……。

ex.en: The author returns to familiar with when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了熟悉……。

tip: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

senses.en: Extremely good and very enjoyable.
Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: Office hours began with a marvellous idea.
ex.zh: 答疑从绝妙的主意开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a marvellous idea.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕绝妙的主意展开说明。

col: a marvellous achievement｜了不起的成就
tip: 英式拼写为marvellous，美式通常为marvelous。

senses.en: Force air suddenly from your throat with a rough sound.
The act or sound of coughing, or an illness causing it.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to cough medicine.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须止咳药。

ex.en: The passage says students who can cough medicine follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够止咳药的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。

senses.en: In a similar way; also true of another person or thing

ex.en: Similarly, one campus is not enough to settle the question.
ex.zh: 相似地，只有一所学校并不足以回答这个问题。

ex.en: Similarly, the lecture treats the two trends as related rather than identical.
ex.zh: 相似地，讲座把这两种趋势视为相关，而不是同一回事。

tip: 句首Similarly常接逗号，用于引出相似情况。

senses.en: who a person is
qualities and beliefs distinguishing a person or group

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about proof of identity.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于身份证明的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects proof of identity with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把身份证明和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: identity指身份；identify是识别、确认身份的动词。

senses.en: The way things actually are, rather than imagined or wished.
Something that actually exists or happens.

ex.en: Office hours began with face reality.
ex.zh: 答疑从面对现实开始。

ex.en: The author returns to face reality when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了面对现实。

tip: in reality意为“实际上”；a reality指已实现的事。

senses.en: Someone who teaches at a university or gives educational talks

ex.en: I copied university lecturer into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把大学讲师抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around university lecturer.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大学讲师展开说明。

tip: 某学科的讲师用lecturer in；不等同于教授。

senses.en: How often something happens or how quickly something changes.
An amount charged or paid for a particular unit.
To judge the quality, value, or level of something.

ex.en: Our professor circled unemployment rate on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了失业率。

ex.en: The reading connects unemployment rate with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把失业率和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: rate可指比率或单位费用；评价某物用rate。

senses.en: the habits and activities that shape how someone lives

ex.en: Our professor circled healthy lifestyle on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了健康的生活方式。

ex.en: A campus survey used healthy lifestyle to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用健康的生活方式来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 可数名词：常说lead a healthy lifestyle。

senses.en: a building used for worship in certain religions
the flat area on either side of the forehead

ex.en: Office hours began with an ancient temple.
ex.zh: 答疑从古庙开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an ancient temple.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕古庙展开说明。

tip: 表示太阳穴时，常用复数temples指两侧。

senses.en: Behave towards someone or consider something in a particular way.
Use medicine or other care to help an illness improve.
Something enjoyable that you do not have very often.

ex.en: The assignment is to treat a disease, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先治疗疾病，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to treat a disease.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来治疗疾病。

col: treat someone with respect｜尊重某人
tip: treat someone to a meal表示请某人吃饭。

senses.en: Fine thread produced by silkworms, or fabric made from it.

ex.en: The textbook introduces pure silk in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了真丝。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of pure silk.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得真丝这个例子。

tip: silk通常不可数；silky指柔滑如丝，不一定是丝制。

senses.en: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.

ex.en: The assignment is to deserve praise, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先值得表扬，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to deserve praise and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你值得表扬，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

senses.en: Relating to the mind and emotional wellbeing.

senses.zh: 脑力的；在头脑中进行的
senses.en: Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about mental health.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于心理健康的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects mental health with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把心理健康和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。

senses.en: money paid in advance, held as security, or banked
to put money or material somewhere for keeping or accumulation
material that builds up naturally in a place

ex.en: Our professor circled refundable deposit on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可退还的押金。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of refundable deposit.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得可退还的押金这个例子。

col: pay a deposit｜支付订金或押金
tip: 订金是预付款；押金作担保；银行存款也用deposit。

senses.en: To die, or cause death, by being unable to breathe underwater.
To cover a sound with a much louder sound.

ex.en: The assignment is to drown out a voice, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先盖过说话声，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to drown out a voice.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来盖过说话声。

col: drown out a voice｜盖过说话声
drown in paperwork｜陷入文书工作
tip: drown指溺死，不只是落水；盖过声音常加out。

senses.en: A distinct part of something larger.
A surface or thin piece exposed by cutting through something.
To divide something into parts or cut it into slices.

ex.en: The textbook introduces final section in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最后一部分。

ex.en: A campus survey used final section to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用最后一部分来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。

senses.en: someone who catches fish for work or pleasure

ex.en: After the lecture, we used fisherman in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了渔民。

ex.en: Students who can explain fisherman usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释渔民的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

tip: 复数为fishermen；中性表达可用fisher。

senses.en: so special or powerful that you will always remember it

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an unforgettable experience.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于难忘的经历的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an unforgettable experience.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕难忘的经历展开说明。

tip: 形容经历令人难忘；forgetful指人健忘。

senses.en: To promote products, services or events through public messages.
To announce publicly that someone or something is wanted.

ex.en: The professor asked us to advertise a product.
ex.zh: 教授让我们为产品做广告。

ex.en: The passage says students who can advertise a product follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够为产品做广告的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: advertise a product｜为产品做广告
advertise for staff｜登广告招聘员工
tip: advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

senses.en: A strip of material wrapped around an injury for protection.
To wrap an injured body part in a bandage.

ex.en: I wrote bandage on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把bandage和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up bandage while discussing evidence about public health.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了绷带。

tip: 既是名词也是动词；bandage a wound意为包扎伤口。

senses.en: a place or institution where legal cases are heard
an area for playing sports such as tennis or basketball
to seek something desirable or risk something harmful

ex.en: Our professor circled tennis court on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了网球场。

ex.en: The author returns to tennis court when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了网球场。

tip: in court指在法庭上；on court指在球场上。

senses.zh: 令人赞叹的；令人钦佩的
senses.en: Causing admiration because of exceptional quality, size, or skill.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on impressive achievement.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论令人赞叹的成就。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around impressive achievement.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕令人赞叹的成就展开说明。

tip: 事物令人赞叹用impressive；人感到佩服用impressed。

senses.en: Used to express what you hope will happen.
In a way that shows hope.

ex.en: The lab manual says to hopefully soon before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先但愿很快，再记下数字。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior asks the class to hopefully soon before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先但愿很快。

col: look hopefully at｜满怀希望地看着
tip: 句首常表示“但愿”，不表示某事一定会发生。

senses.en: the reason for doing something or what something is intended for
a feeling of having meaningful aims in life

ex.en: I copied main purpose into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把主要目的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to main purpose when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主要目的。

tip: on purpose意为“故意地”，不是“有目的地”。

senses.en: damage to the environment caused by harmful substances or energy

ex.en: Our professor circled air pollution on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了空气污染。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss air pollution.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论空气污染的材料。

tip: pollution不可数；具体污染物用pollutant。

senses.en: A wheeled chair used by someone who has difficulty walking.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on electric wheelchair.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电动轮椅。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss electric wheelchair.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电动轮椅的材料。

tip: 说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。

senses.zh: 有组织的运动；宣传活动
senses.en: A series of organised activities aimed at achieving a goal
To organise or take part in activities supporting a cause
A series of military operations with a particular objective

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于广告宣传活动的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论广告宣传活动的材料。

col: an advertising campaign｜广告宣传活动
campaign for reform｜为改革开展运动
campaign against pollution｜开展反污染运动
tip: 动词后接for表示争取，接against表示反对。

senses.en: All space and everything that exists within it
A complete world of experiences, ideas, or imagined events

ex.en: I copied the expanding universe into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把不断膨胀的宇宙抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the expanding universe.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕不断膨胀的宇宙展开说明。

col: the expanding universe｜不断膨胀的宇宙
the origins of the universe｜宇宙的起源
tip: 指宇宙通常用the universe；开头是辅音音素/j/。

senses.en: The family, education, and experience that shape someone's life
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a professional background.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论职业背景。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a professional background.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得职业背景这个例子。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: To save someone or something from danger or difficulty.
An act of saving someone or something from danger.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to rescue someone from.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须从……中救出某人。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to rescue someone from.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来从……中救出某人。

col: rescue someone from｜从……中救出某人
come to the rescue｜前来解围
tip: 常用rescue sb from sth，表示从险境中救出某人。

senses.en: A written instruction asking a bank to pay a specified amount.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize cheque/check in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出支票。

ex.en: Students who can explain cheque/check usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释支票的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

col: a bounced check｜被退回的支票
tip: 支票英式拼写为cheque，美式为check，读音相同。
note: 并列英美拼写，并非单一词头。

senses.en: To officially forbid an activity or the use of something
An official rule that forbids something

ex.en: The lab instructions say to ban smoking.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求禁止吸烟。

ex.en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to ban smoking.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们禁止吸烟。

col: a ban on something｜对某事物的禁令
tip: ban doing；ban sb from doing；过去式banned。

senses.en: a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person
a detailed description of a person, place, or situation

ex.en: Office hours began with a family portrait.
ex.zh: 答疑从全家福开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a family portrait with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把全家福和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: portrait以人物为主体；landscape多指风景画或照片。

senses.en: the basic verb form, used with or without to
relating to or using the basic form of a verb

ex.en: Our professor circled a bare infinitive on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不带to的不定式。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a bare infinitive.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得不带to的不定式这个例子。

col: a bare infinitive｜不带to的不定式
tip: 不定式可带to，也可不带；如to go与must go中的go。

senses.en: the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm

ex.en: Office hours began with environmental protection.
ex.zh: 答疑从环境保护开始。

ex.en: The reading connects environmental protection with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把环境保护和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常不可数；protection from/against表示免受伤害。

senses.en: things that belong to a person or organisation
land or buildings that someone owns
a quality of a substance or material

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on private property.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论私人财产。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of private property.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得私人财产这个例子。

tip: 财产义不可数；房产和性质义可数。
